brief: Clear the overgrown shrub cover restricting the airflow path to the rear of the unit and the vegetation encroaching on the compound fence within a metre of the radiators, complete the work order for the cooling controller, and apply the loading restriction in MG-021 until the oil with marginal dielectric strength is reconditioned or replaced and retested. Cite doc_ids MG-021, MG-023, SOP-013.
